invalidated.reason: Acquisition defect: the AOI extends ~2.4 km past the east edge of tile 44PLV (native window cols 10570-11224 of 10980). rasterio silently clipped the read to 410 columns and the writer stretched them across the declared 654-column window, so both rasters are geometrically wrong while their metadata claims the full AOI. Detected by a same-datatake cross-tile comparison (44PLV vs 44PMV correlated 0.11). Acquisition now fails closed on windows outside the tile and on clipped reads. Replaced by water-puzhal-lake-2018-2019-pmv; the committed provenance is kept unchanged as evidence.
